intro: Buhísimo's four prototype poses (owl-explaining, owl-celebrating, owl-encouraging, owl-thinking) redrawn in the flat style of the current Max and Matilda: same style text as remake_flat, NAG off (scale 1.0), no negative prompt, 6 seeds per pose. Ear tufts: every prompt that used the English word 'owl' gave tufts (24 of 24 tries in tuft_tests/, even with 'smooth round head, no ear tufts' in the positive prompt). Naming the species as 'buho de anteojos (Pulsatrix perspicillata)' with 'his head is a big perfect circle like a full moon' fixed it: 0 of 24 final images have ear tufts (three have a small single feather on top and are rejected). Seed 3 gives the most consistent set across all four poses (same turquoise strap, bag, brows and glasses), so all four picks are seed 3. Nothing is wired into the prototype yet.
